aggregation.missing: null with specific reasons; no imputation, person borrowing or alternative nights
aggregation.within_person: mean of both separately named night medians

cohorts.interpretation: Previously unexamined people within the audited EEGT program; same source/setup. Foundation-model pretraining overlap UNKNOWN.
New nights for development people. Do not pool with new people or call them new people.

freeze_execution_gate: Protocol candidate bytes frozen for independent review; no empirical access until root-owned ACCEPTED RUN-SOURCE-MANIFEST binds accepted reviews, these exact bytes, executable source and native resource admission.

intake_resource_control.cpu_scope: Per stage invocation; repeated first-record work is recorded separately, not hidden.
intake_resource_control.first_record_gate: Each stage stops after the first fixed source record for a hash-bound root resource admission before proceeding. A missing or quarantined first record is explicitly limited evidence; admission must consider the exposed full-record profile and planned source sizes. First-record replay preserves equal numeric arrays.
intake_resource_control.measurement_boundary: Before and after each full record; CPU/RSS/artifact checks are record-boundary refusals, not OS hard limits. One record can overshoot before refusal.

multiplicity.raw_test: Exact participant sign flip with sign-symmetry assumption; same scientific statistic as Experiment 012.
multiplicity.scope: All eight primary cohort/model/metric tests; no cohort selection after results.

open_before_freeze: Implement interfaces without editing released scientific functions
Prove new interface against synthetic and exposed fixtures only
Seal actual executable source and runtime after acceptance, before any reserved payload acquisition or opening

preprocessing.filter: Per-block scipy fourth-order Butterworth bandpass0.3-75Hz, sosfiltfilt with10seconds reflected padding inside the30sblock; then60Hz IIR notch Q30 with the same pad length. No filter crosses block/gap boundaries.
preprocessing.resampling: scipy resample_poly up4 down5, default Kaiser beta5.0 antialias filter, constant padding, axis=time; exact6000samples.
preprocessing.scale: Known microvolt values divided by100; no fitted normalization, channel substitution, interpolation, imputation or reference change.
preprocessing.training_recipe_limit: Band and notch frequencies and uV/100 scale follow author sources; exact filtering implementation is an explicit engineering choice, not a claim of byte-identical pretraining preprocessing.

quality.rule: Unchanged Experiment009 numerical predicates. Preserve every candidate, all rejection reasons and separate quality qualification from time-stratified selection. No threshold adjustment, re-referencing, amplitude normalization or filtering change after this freeze. Native gap overlap rejects the block. Same selected original support for all five waveform variants.

release_dependency: Experiment 012 must be accepted and publicly verified before final validation protocol acceptance.

second_source.decision: Include the prespecified native-only engineering check, pending independent protocol acceptance; both encoder statuses remain NOT_EVALUATED_FOR_12_CONTACTS.
second_source.encoder_reason: Both currently accepted EEGT adapters require four channels. No reviewed 12-contact mapping, so no fabricated channel/position or physiological-scale substitution.

native_engineering_scope.channels: All12 actual ear EEG contacts in the accepted qualification order; exclude EOGr
native_engineering_scope.inference: Descriptive technical support/event counts only; no p values, population transfer, universal tokens or brain-state interpretation
native_engineering_scope.inputs: Exact qualified source hashes and conservative validity masks; record numeric sample/mask hashes before detector invocation
native_engineering_scope.selection: First30seconds of each of the two already-qualified EESM19nights005and006, no adaptive replacement

second_source.proposal: First 30 seconds of both qualified nights, all 12 actual EEG contacts and accepted masks, unchanged native waveform detector; no adaptive replacement. Independent review must accept this optional small engineering scope before freeze.
second_source.source_role: Previously technically qualified development intake, not held-out population transfer

secondary_cross_encoder.reuse: Accepted scientific distance/rank/support calculations; no new fit
secondary_cross_encoder.scope: Descriptive numerical replication of geometry and change; no alternate primary success claim

selection.rule: Lower temporal median of fixed quality-passing candidates in each nonempty stratum; no substitution or later-session extension. Keep missing source records and short support as explicit rejected candidates.
